intro.content: At Fashion, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our website.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: Welcome to Fashion. By using our website, you agree to comply with these Terms and Conditions. Please read them carefully.

account.title: User Account
account.content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password. You agree to accept responsibility for all activities that occur under your account.

items.placement: All orders are subject to acceptance and availability
items.confirmation: You will receive an email confirmation upon order acceptance
items.cancellation: Orders can be cancelled before shipment
items.modification: Orders cannot be modified after confirmation

pricing.title: Pricing and Payment
pricing.content: All prices are in Egyptian Pounds and include taxes. We reserve the right to change prices at any time without prior notice.

shipping.title: Shipping and Delivery
shipping.content: We ship to all governorates of Egypt. Delivery times vary by location and may take 2-7 business days.

returns.title: Returns and Exchanges
returns.content: You can return products within 14 days of receipt provided they are in original condition with all tags.

payment.title: Payment Methods
payment.content: We accept cash on delivery and electronic payment via credit cards and e-wallets.

intellectual.title: Intellectual Property
intellectual.content: All content on this website, including text, images, and logos, is proprietary to Fashion and protected by copyright laws.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content: Fashion is not liable for any direct, indirect, or incidental damages arising from the use or inability to use the website.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. Changes will become effective upon posting on the website.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about these Terms and Conditions, please contact us.
